Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia May Be Postponed Amid Regional Attacks

The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) is considering the postponement of the 2027 Asian Cup, scheduled to begin on January 7 in Saudi Arabian cities including Jeddah, Riyadh, and Al Khobar. This consideration comes in light of recent attacks in Saudi Arabia that have disrupted the sports calendar. Despite the potential for postponement, Saudi organizers maintain that the 2027 Asian Cup remains 'on schedule'. The AFC has stated there is no immediate rush to make a decision regarding the tournament's timing.
